patch.summary:
Thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Adapt.io and LeadIQ share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs. Choose Adapt.io only if your buying job matches “Regional B2B contact database with credit plans — Free; Starter $49/mo; Basic $99/mo; Cust” rather than LeadIQ's shape. Choose LeadIQ only if your buying job matches “Chrome/LinkedIn-adjacent capture and CRM sync with Universal Credits — Free 50 credits; Pr” rather than Adapt.io's shape. Workflow advantage: Adapt.io leans contact-management; LeadIQ leans lead-management. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Adapt.io and LeadIQ share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.
- Positioning: Adapt.io is Regional B2B contact database with credit plans — Free; Starter $49/mo; Basic $99/mo; Custom contact sales; 7-day trial.; LeadIQ is Chrome/LinkedIn-adjacent capture and CRM sync with Universal Credits — Free 50 credits; Pro from $200/mo..
- Company-size focus: Adapt.io (micro, small-business, mid-market) vs LeadIQ (small-business, mid-market).
- Workflow coverage skew: Adapt.io-leaning contact-management vs LeadIQ-leaning lead-management.
- Researched limits: Adapt.io — Thinner global mega-database depth than UpLead/Hunter/Apollo-class peers for many buyer niches; LeadIQ — Pro starts at $200/mo — higher entry than many SMB contact tools.

Limitations — Adapt.io: Thinner global mega-database depth than UpLead/Hunter/Apollo-class peers for many buyer niches; No native email sequencing — data/export first; LeadIQ: Pro starts at $200/mo — higher entry than many SMB contact tools; Native email sequencing depth is limited versus dedicated engagement platforms.

Poor-fit cases: Adapt.io is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Thinner global mega-database depth than UpLead/Hunter/Apollo-class peers for many buyer niches · LeadIQ is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Pro starts at $200/mo — higher entry than many SMB contact tools · Avoid Adapt.io if you actually need LeadIQ's motion (Chrome/LinkedIn-adjacent capture and CRM sync with Universal Credits — Free 50 c)

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
